title: QuestionInteraction
description: Claude asking the person something (`AskUserQuestion`) rather than asking leave to run a tool, with the questions the backend normalised out of the SDK's input. A client renders this and never reads the SDK's `input` (plan 24).

kind.description: The only variant for now. `plan` (for `ExitPlanMode`) would be the second, and the generator has no `oneOf` yet.

malformed.description: The SDK's input could not be read safely — no questions or more than four, fewer than two or more than four options, an option with no label, a question with no options, a question repeated, a label repeated within a question. `questions` is then empty, the card offers only a refusal, and an `allow` is refused with `PERMISSION_ANSWERS_INVALID`.

questions.description: One to four, in the order Claude asked them; empty when `malformed`.

id.description: `q1`…`q4`, by position — stable within the request, and what an answer names.

header.description: The short chip of the question (the SDK asks for 12 characters; the model does not always obey). Cut, never refused.

prompt.description: The question itself, as Claude wrote it. Text to show, never markup. Cut, never refused.

multiSelect.description: Several options may be chosen. A single choice is one label, or the free answer (`other`).

options.description: What Claude offers. The free answer ("Other") is not here: the screen offers it.

label.description: Shown and answered exactly as it is — a label ending in "(Recommended)" keeps it, and a screen may highlight it but never pre-select it.

preview.description: A mockup or a snippet, in markdown, rendered with the safe renderer — never HTML. Absent when the option has none.
